verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Mem0 Open Source as the same memory engine as the Platform running on your own infrastructure, with full control of the stack and data. They also document a self-hosted Docker bundle that includes the REST API, a web dashboard, an admin account, per-user API keys, and a request audit log. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the self-hosted deployment, and explicit confirmation that Platform features such as built-in graph memory reach parity in the self-hosted stack.
